plan: A clown jungler who turns invisible, places trapped boxes and strikes from behind.
aSurveiller: His Q (Deceive). He turns invisible and reappears behind you for a critical strike: place a control ward where he passes.
contrer: Buy a control ward or the Oracle Lens: they reveal his boxes and help you spot him.
Don't chase a Shaco without vision: his R creates a clone and his boxes make you flee.
Stay near your allies: he attacks isolated targets.

sorts.P: More damage when he strikes from behind.
sorts.Q: Turns invisible and teleports; next attack empowered.
sorts.W: Places a hidden box that fears and attacks.
sorts.E: Poison that slows; he can throw a dagger.
sorts.R: Creates a clone that explodes, leaving boxes behind.

momentFort: Dangerous from level 2 in the jungle, and at any time if he finds you alone.
